lead_independence.headline: First Border Collies adopted after Palm City hoarding rescue, Humane Society says
lead_independence.lead: The Humane Society of the Treasure Coast has begun placing Border Collies rescued from a Palm City hoarding case into new homes, marking a major milestone in the dogs' recovery less than a month after Martin County deputies and Animal Services removed 36 Border Collies from a home on Southwest Alligator Street in Palm City. The shelter said it has slowly started facilitating adoptions and shared photos from one of the first successful placements. Shelter staff will stay in regular contact with adopters, conduct follow-up checks and provide support during the transition, and training classes will be available for dogs needing extra attention or help adjusting to life in a home.
